title: Administration; rules.
bodyText: The department shall adopt such rules under chapter 91 as may be necessary to carry into effect this chapter, including rules relating to the return for taxes due under this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§236D-10]  Administration; rules.  The department shall adopt such rules under chapter 91 as may be necessary to carry into effect this chapter, including rules relating to the return for taxes due under this chapter. [L 1983, c 217, pt of §1]
